canonical_source.source: Animation Factory: Earth Needs Help Pipeline master sheet uploaded in chat
canonical_source.lock_rule: No recurring character may be redesigned without explicit user approval.

captain-pip.identity: green rounded alien captain with large expressive eyes, white captain hat and dark captain uniform exactly as in the approved visual reference

bloop.identity: blue round alien with antennae and huge expressive eyes exactly as in the approved visual reference

zig.identity: purple tall slim alien inventor exactly as in the approved visual reference

momo.identity: pink small calm alien with large ear/head-side features exactly as in the approved visual reference

human-child.identity: brown-haired stylised Earth child in blue hoodie exactly as in the approved visual reference

reference_pack.runtime_reference_strategy: decode and hash-check all five approved crops, then compose an equal-weight five-character reference sheet in memory for every still-generation kernel
reference_pack.note: These files are direct crops from the user-approved MAIN CHARACTERS consistency row. The obsolete corrupt single character-lock.b64 asset has been removed.
